name: Legacy
overview: Scripture reveals that legacy encompasses both the consequences of our actions across generations and the intentional transmission of faith and devotion to God. God warns that iniquity can affect descendants up to the third and fourth generation (Exodus 20:5), emphasizing the weight of our choices. At the same time, believers are called to love the LORD wholeheartedly and to keep His commandments deeply rooted in their hearts (Deuteronomy 6:5-6), so that His praises and mighty works can be faithfully shared with future generations (Psalms 78:4). The remembrance of God's faithfulness, as well as the example of godly ancestors like Rachel and Leah who built the house of Israel (Ruth 4:11), serves to inspire and instruct children, ensuring that the legacy of faith endures.
